proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_creature_searches
proposed_widenings.justification: The camouflage mechanic requires a trigger that fires when a creature takes the Search action on the area, paired with an ability_check_gate (Wis Perception or Survival vs spell save DC). The existing on_creature_studies trigger maps to the Study standard action, not Search. Both are distinct standard action kinds in SRD 5.2.1.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

notes: Primary mechanics (Difficult Terrain + 2d4 piercing per 5 ft moved) encode cleanly using existing area_is_difficult_terrain and on_creature_moves(perFeet=5). Typecheck passes, tracer emits a clean graph. The camouflage/recognition mechanic is omitted: it needs an on_creature_searches trigger (Search action is distinct from Study in SRD 5.2.1) plus a Wis(Perception or Survival) vs DC ability_check_gate. The 'can't see the area at cast time' predicate is also caller-resolved, but the check itself is deterministic. The skill filter (Perception OR Survival) would additionally need SkillFilter with kind='fixed' and two skills, which is already supported in the surface.
